title: VENSUKO Launcher 0.16.1 - Discord Sign-in & Feedback
notes:
VENSUKO Launcher 0.16.1 - Discord Sign-in & Feedback

- Sign in or register with Discord through the system browser on Windows and macOS, with an authenticated return to the Launcher and secure PKCE session exchange.
- Keep the existing email-and-password login, account verification, OS-protected sessions and account profiles intact.
- Retain all v0.16.0 feedback features: Launcher Settings feedback, game-specific bug reports and ideas, and protected server relay to the support Discord channel.
- Preserve existing game libraries, saved games, DropDash account integration, profile customization and account settings.
- Release the same version for Windows, Intel Macs and Apple Silicon Macs with separate signed updater packages.
